discard.title: Discard draft v{{version}}?
discard.sentence: Its changes are lost. Published v{{version}} stays the version new runs use.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.unused: No pipeline step uses it. Finished runs keep showing the version they ran.
remove.unusedInstruction: No agent gets it from its next run on. Finished runs keep showing the version they ran.
remove.unusedSkill: No agent gets this skill now. Finished runs keep showing the version they ran.
remove.inUseProfile: Remove and reset deletes it and clears it from every user: each step below loses its profile, and its pipeline’s draft asks you to choose one.
remove.inUseTool: Remove and reset deletes it and clears it from every user: each step below loses its tool, and its pipeline’s draft asks you to choose one.
remove.inUseSkillOne: Remove and reset deletes it and clears it from every user: {{name}} no longer gets this skill.
remove.inUseSkillOther: Remove and reset deletes it and clears it from every user: the agents below no longer get this skill.

leave.title: Leave with unsaved changes?
leave.sentence: Saved drafts are kept. Changes that have not saved will be left behind.

failure.stillWorks: Runs keep going, and the other tabs that read their own data still open.
